title: 第23章 打打打第24章 在下温郗青云榜榜首温郗大章
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
那威势惊人的火网在被温郗这几道灵力击中的瞬间开始剧烈颤抖起来，原本流畅运转的灵力开始滞涩。
赤红色的光芒明灭不定，瞬间露出一个缺口。
温郗仿佛早已算准了这个缺口出现的位置和时间，第一时间从那缺口一掠而出。炽热的火舌朝着她的背影涌去，却终究慢了一步。
她稳稳落在火网之外，呼吸有些急促，衣摆已经全部烧焦。
整个决斗台下，死一般的寂静。
何亦瞳孔骤缩，脸上第一次出现了骇然之色：“你…你怎么可能？！”
温郗站定身形，目光清亮地看着他。
事实上，这些破绽并不难找。
何亦的招数总是追求极致的范围包围和威力，却忽略了输出庞大灵力时各布点间的相互平衡。
左下方靠近外围的布点，右下方贴近他手臂的布点，还有中心靠上的灵力凝结点……这几处的灵力流转速度跟其他地方有着微弱的不同。
只要对这几点进行精准干扰，便会让他的火海失去稳定，找到破绽。
小明：‘……’
宿主真的是才练气九重吗？
这种洞察力，这种敏锐度真的是一个练气九重的修士能做到的吗？
它沉默良久，还是只说了一句——
‘宿主，你真是天生的修士。’
上辈子重病在身真是耽误她了。
温郗：‘我也不知道，总觉得打着打着眼睛就看透这些了。’
眼见拿温郗没办法，何亦的脸色转为涨红，理智逐渐被怒火淹没，他猛地一拍胸脯，一道赤芒自他身后飞出——
那把重剑出鞘了。

重剑悬浮于空中，散发出恐怖的炽热，让周围的空气都变得滚烫。
台下响起一片惊呼：“何亦拔剑了，他动真格的了！”
然而，就在何亦将全部心神都用于沟通法器时，温郗利用这个极其短暂的瞬间采取了行动。
可以说，她等的就是这个机会。
温郗在书上看到过，刚刚突破筑基的修士在唤出本命法器时，心神与法器相连最紧密，却也是最不容打扰的时刻。
简单来说，就是施法前摇。
而她选择打断施法。
温郗将周身练气九重的木系灵力以前所未有的强度压缩后，尽数汇聚于右手食指指尖。
那指尖骤然爆发出璀璨纯粹的碧绿色光芒，仿佛凝聚了无限生机。
下一刻，她双手结印，绿色灵力直奔何亦而去。
它精准无比地射向那赤色小幡与何亦眉心之间的位置。
温郗的灵力速度快得超乎想象，瞬间来到何亦面前，他只觉得有什么东西被刺破，灵力骤然回涌。
赤炎剑猛地发出一声哀鸣，剑刃上燃烧的烈焰失去控制，瞬间攻向何亦与之相连的神识。
何亦急忙后撤一步，重新调整体内的灵力。
content_en:
The astonishingly powerful fire net began to tremble violently the moment it was hit by Wen Xi's spiritual power, and the spiritual power that was originally running smoothly began to stagnate.
The crimson light flickered on and off, revealing a gap in an instant.
Wen Xi seemed to have already calculated the location and time of the gap, and immediately rushed out of the gap. The fiery tongues of fire rushed towards her back, but in the end they took a step slower.
She landed firmly outside the fire net, her breathing was a little rapid, and the hem of her clothes was completely charred.
The entire duel stage was filled with deathly silence.
He Yi's pupils shrank suddenly, and for the first time a look of horror appeared on his face: "You...how could you?!"
Wen Xi stood still and looked at him with clear eyes.
In fact, these flaws are not difficult to find.
He Yi's moves always pursue the ultimate range of coverage and power, but ignore the mutual balance between the various points when outputting huge spiritual power.
The dots on the lower left near the periphery, the dots on the lower right close to his arm, and the spiritual power condensation point near the center... The speed of spiritual power flow in these places is slightly different from other places.
As long as these points are accurately interfered with, his sea of ​​fire will lose stability and find flaws.
Xiao Ming: ‘…’
Is the host really at the ninth level of Qi training?
Can this kind of insight and sensitivity really be achieved by a monk at the ninth level of Qi training?
It was silent for a long time, but still only said one sentence——
‘Host, you are truly a born monk. ’
Being seriously ill in her previous life really delayed her.
Wen Xi: ‘I don’t know either, I always feel like I can see through it just by opening my eyes. ’
Seeing that there was nothing he could do to defeat Wen Xi, He Yi's face turned red, and his reason was gradually overwhelmed by anger. He suddenly slapped his chest, and a red light flew out from behind him——
The heavy sword was unsheathed.
The heavy sword was suspended in the air, emitting terrifying heat, making the surrounding air hot.
There was an exclamation in the audience: "He Yi has drawn his sword, he is serious about it!"
However, just when He Yi devoted all his attention to communicating with the magic weapon, Wen Xi took advantage of this extremely brief moment to take action.
It can be said that this is the opportunity she has been waiting for.
Wen Xi had read in a book that when a monk who had just broken through the Foundation Establishment summoned his natal magic weapon, his mind was most closely connected with the magic weapon, but it was also the moment that should not be disturbed.
To put it simply, it is the forward swing of the spell.
And she chose to interrupt the spellcasting.
Wen Xi compressed the wood spiritual power of the ninth level of Qi training all over his body with unprecedented strength, and then concentrated it on the tip of his right index finger.
The fingertips suddenly erupted with bright and pure turquoise light, as if boundless vitality was condensed.
The next moment, she formed a seal with her hands, and the green spiritual power went straight towards He Yi.
It shot with incomparable accuracy to the position between the red flag and He Yi's eyebrows.
Wen Xi's spiritual power was so fast that it was beyond imagination. He was in front of He Yi in an instant. He felt like something had been pierced and his spiritual power suddenly surged back.
The red flame sword suddenly let out a cry, and the flames burning on the blade lost control and instantly attacked He Yi's consciousness connected to it.
He Yi hurriedly took a step back to readjust the spiritual power in his body.
